exposure: ELOVL4 compound heterozygous variants c.208C>T (p.Arg70Ter) and c.487T>C (p.Cys163Arg)
outcome: severe gastro-esophageal reflux with pulmonary aspiration
markedly increased latency and poor morphological definition in Visual Evoked Potentials (indicative of alteration of retro-retinal visual pathways)
abnormalities of lamellar bodies with altered release in the epidermal granular and horny layer intracellular spaces
cohort: Two Italian children affected with neuro-ichthyosis due to previously undescribed ELOVL4 homozygous frameshift and compound heterozygous variants.
finding: The study identified novel ELOVL4 gene variants (c.435dupT and compound c.208C>T/c.487T>C) and described their associated clinical and ultrastructural features, thereby expanding the known phenotypic and genotypic spectrum of ELOVL4-related neuro-ichthyosis.
